items.summary: Election signs were still up in Mississauga, Ont. on Tuesday, the day after voters chose a first-term councillor as their next mayor. They elected Alvin Tedjo over both the incumbent, Carolyn Parrish, and her predecessor, Bonnie Crombie.

items.title: Polymarket faces renewed CFTC probe over U.S. access to offshore platform
items.summary: The federal agency had previously investigated whether Polymarket allowed U.S. users on to its offshore platform in 2024, but dropped the measures in July 2025.

items.title: From incumbents losing to voter turnout: These are the top takeaways from the GTA elections
items.summary: Toronto voters have decided to hand Olivia Chow a second term as mayor in a landslide win that saw challenger Brad Bradford finish with nearly 130,000 fewer votes.

items.title: Carney says Ottawa's Indian Act review might not end up abolishing the law

items.title: Unclaimed $40 million Lotto Max ticket in Grey County set to expire Wednesday
items.summary: Ontario Lottery and Gaming (OLG) said the winning ticket from the Oct. 28, 2025 Lotto Max draw will expire by the end of Wednesday, Oct. 28, 2026 if no one steps forward to claim the prize.
